credit.notes: Credit cards managed by PNB Card services. .

debit.notes: Via PNB One app: Cards > Hotlist. SMS HOTLIST <Last4> to 5607040.

upi.notes: UPI FAQ ('I have faced unauthorized debit through UPI'): 'In case of unauthorized debit through PNB account linked on any UPI enabled app, please block UPI through following channels: Branch, Call centre, Forwarding debit SMS to 92640 92640, Internet Banking, PNB one.' PNB One feature list publishes 'UPI Blocking' under UPI Services; the UPI module is reached by 'Click UPI icon under Pay & Transfer module' (bank FAQ). Lost phone: 'Open Internet banking URL - https://ibanking.pnb.bank.in Choose Retail Internet Banking Enter User ID Disable Mobile/Internet Banking' (freezes mobile/internet banking; UPI itself uses the block channels above); or call '1800 1800, 1800 2021, 0120-2490000'; or SMS 'BLOCK MBS CUSTID' to 9264092640; or WhatsApp 9264092640 emergency menu. *99# (NPCI USSD) is a published PNB UPI platform but only for payments/UPI PIN setup, not blocking. Bank's own UPI app: 'PNB UPI App has now been renamed to BHIM PNB' (Play link on bank's UPI page: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.fss.pnbpsp). Digital-products care line: 1800-330-3333. No iOS store URL published on fetched pages.
